name: How long does a typical kitchen remodel take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen remodel take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen remodel can vary significantly based on the scope and complexity of the project. A minor refresh might take 2-4 weeks, while a complete gut and renovation, especially one involving structural changes or custom elements, could take 8-12 weeks or more. Factors like material lead times, permit processing, and unexpected discoveries can also influence the timeline. Cali View Builders provides a detailed project schedule upfront.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen remodel can take 2-12 weeks, depending on the project's scope, from minor refreshes to full renovations. Factors like material lead times and permits can also affect the timeline.
